title: FingerTip 20K: A Benchmark for Proactive and Personalized Mobile LLM Agents
authors_zh: Qinglong Yang, Haoming Li, Haotian Zhao, Xiaokai Yan, Jingtao Ding, Fengli Xu, Yong Li
paper_type_zh: 移动 GUI 智能体纵向轨迹数据集与混合反馈基准
best_for_zh: 研究移动智能体 SFT、个性化交互评测、轨迹发布审计、隐私风险与 live environment 复现边界的读者
one_line: A longitudinal Android benchmark of human state-action episodes for intent anticipation and preference-conditioned execution, with a verified gap between the paper's 21,437-episode corpus and the public 20,000-row index.
FingerTip 20K 以纵向用户画像和真实 Android 状态—动作示范支持主动意图预测与个性化执行，但论文的 21,437 个 episode 与公开索引的 20,000 行无法对齐，终态成功还依赖未编码进脚本的人工判断。
why: It shows how user profiles, time, location, intent history, screenshots, accessibility trees, and human action traces can become both supervised agent data and a benchmark surface; it also exposes why episode counts, manual terminal judgments, privacy filtering, and live-app replay metadata must be audited before reuse.
inclusion_reason: FingerTip 20K makes the post-training object unusually concrete for mobile agents: a longitudinal, user-conditioned screenshot/XML/action episode is reused both as an SFT target and as the basis of two evaluation tracks. It belongs in the atlas because its human trajectory schema and mixed feedback contract are reusable, while the paper/release count mismatch, manual success labeling, privacy exposure, and non-pinned live environment are material audit findings.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The accepted OpenReview record identifies this work as an ICLR 2026 conference paper, and the official venue page lists it as an ICLR 2026 Poster. The stable atlas ID retains the 2025 preprint suffix, but the canonical publication year is 2026. The paper asks how a mobile agent can anticipate what a particular user wants to do and then execute that intent in a way conditioned on the user's history, rather than treating every phone task as a context-free instruction (Paper §§1–3; OpenReview and ICLR records).

FingerTip 20K studies this question through longitudinal human Android demonstrations collected during daily use. The paper reports 21,437 episodes from 95 mainland-China users across 506 apps, averaging 11.1 steps. One episode is a participant's current intent plus timestamp and scenario, user-linked context, ordered JPG screenshots, accessibility-tree XML observations, and JSONL GUI actions ending in an added finish marker. It is a human demonstration, not a unique task template, prompt, search tree, or model rollout (Paper Table 1, §4.2, Appendix A.4).

The work belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the reusable object is a state–action episode tied to a real phone substrate and then consumed by two agent-facing tracks: proactive suggestion and personalized execution. It is both a data release and a benchmark, but not a packaged replayable environment. The public artifacts do not pin app/APK versions, accounts, initial device state, Android images, reset logic, or deterministic replay manifests.

The Card reaches L4 content depth while retaining L3 metadata status because several audit gaps remain unresolved. Most importantly, the official GitHub total.csv contains 20,000 rows from 83 users and 482 app identifiers, not the paper's 21,437/95/506 corpus; no official mapping explains the reduction. The evidence supports screening for offline SFT, benchmark evaluation, and release auditing, but not a claim that every retained demonstration succeeded, that the public index equals the full paper corpus, or that live execution can be reproduced deterministically.

OpenReview 的接收记录将该工作列为 ICLR 2026 conference paper，官方会场页面将其列为 ICLR 2026 Poster。Atlas 的稳定 ID 保留 2025 年预印本后缀，但 canonical publication year 是 2026。论文关注的不是把每个手机任务都当成脱离上下文的指令，而是如何让移动智能体预测某位具体用户当前想做什么，并依据该用户的历史完成相应操作（论文第 1–3 节；OpenReview 与 ICLR 官方记录）。

FingerTip 20K 通过日常使用中纵向采集的人类 Android 示范研究这一问题。论文报告 21,437 个 episode，来自中国大陆 95 位用户、覆盖 506 个 app，平均 11.1 步。单个 episode 包含参与者当时记录的 intent、时间与场景、用户相关上下文、按序排列的 JPG screenshot、accessibility-tree XML 观测，以及以新增 finish 标记结束的 JSONL GUI 动作。它是人类示范，不是独立任务模板、prompt、搜索树或模型 rollout（论文表 1、第 4.2 节、附录 A.4）。

该工作属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为可复用对象是绑定真实手机 substrate 的状态—动作 episode，并分别进入 proactive suggestion 与 personalized execution 两个智能体任务。它既是数据发布也是 benchmark，但不是打包好的可回放环境；公开材料没有固定 app/APK 版本、账号、设备初始状态、Android image、reset 逻辑或 deterministic replay manifest。

本卡正文达到 L4 深度，但元数据继续保持 L3，原因是若干审计缺口尚未解决。最关键的差异是：官方 GitHub total.csv 只有 20,000 行、83 位用户和 482 个 app 标识，而不是论文的 21,437/95/506；官方材料没有解释缩减映射。现有证据足以支持离线 SFT、benchmark evaluation 与发布审计的论文筛选，却不足以证明每条保留示范都成功、公开索引等于论文完整语料，或 live execution 可以确定性复现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a longitudinal, user-conditioned mobile episode object that supports two different predictions: infer the user's likely current intent from profile/history/context, or predict the next GUI action from the current intent, phone state, action history, and a retrieved same-user demonstration. The same human episode therefore acts as an SFT target and as the source of benchmark inputs and references (Paper §§3–5).

For proactive suggestion, the input contains the user profile, timestamp, scenario, up to 20 previous intents, and zero to three initial screenshots; the output is one Chinese sentence naming the app and desired final effect. For personalized execution, the model receives the current intent, profile, screenshot, accessibility elements, executed-action history, and one earlier same-user action sequence retrieved by intent similarity, then emits one action in a live ADB loop. The stored app/activity launches the app for evaluation but is not exposed to the agent (Paper §§3.1–3.2, §5.1, Appendix A.7; official scripts).

The feedback contract is mixed. Suggestion uses Sim1, the average of multilingual sentence-embedding cosine similarity and Levenshtein similarity, plus SR1, a DeepSeek-V3 binary same-intent judgment. Execution uses manually inspected final-state success (SR2), automatic failure beyond 2.5 times the human demonstration length, an action-sequence personalization ratio (Sim2), and a step ratio. These signals can observe semantic resemblance, path resemblance, budget compliance, or a human-perceived final state; they do not provide a released dense reward, automatic per-step correctness, or a public executable success predicate. The proactive script omits SR1, while the execution script has no manual adjudicator and writes success=0 (Paper §5.1; official scripts).

Compared with generalist mobile-agent systems evaluated in the paper, including UI-TARS-1.5-7B on execution, FingerTip 20K changes the data and evaluation surface rather than proposing a new agent architecture: longitudinal user identity, profile, time/scenario, prior intents, and retrieved same-user behavior become explicit inputs. Its distinguishing direction is personalized and proactive mobile-agent data, not a new Android action vocabulary or an automatically verified environment.

核心贡献是一种纵向、用户条件化的移动端 episode 对象，用同一类数据支持两种预测：依据画像、历史与场景推断用户当前可能的 intent；或者依据当前 intent、手机状态、动作历史以及检索到的同用户示范预测下一步 GUI 动作。因此，同一条人类 episode 既可成为 SFT target，也构成 benchmark 输入与参照的来源（论文第 3–5 节）。

在 proactive suggestion 中，输入包括 user profile、时间、场景、最多 20 条历史 intent，以及 0–3 张初始 screenshot；输出是一句中文，点明 app 与期望最终效果。在 personalized execution 中，模型接收当前 intent、画像、screenshot、accessibility element、已执行动作历史，以及按 intent 相似度检索的一条同用户历史动作序列，然后在 live ADB loop 中逐步输出动作。存储的 app/activity 用于评测时启动 app，但不会提供给 agent（论文第 3.1–3.2、5.1 节、附录 A.7；官方脚本）。

反馈契约是 mixed。Suggestion 使用 Sim1——多语言句向量 cosine similarity 与 Levenshtein similarity 的均值——以及 DeepSeek-V3 对 intent 是否相同的二元判断 SR1。Execution 使用人工检查最终手机状态得到的成功率 SR2、超过人类示范长度 2.5 倍即自动失败的规则、动作序列个性化比值 Sim2 和 step ratio。这些信号分别观察语义相似、路径相似、预算约束或人工感知的终态，却没有提供可发布的 dense reward、自动逐步正确性或公开可执行的成功谓词。公开 proactive 脚本没有实现 SR1，execution 脚本也没有人工终态裁决器，并把 success 写成 0（论文第 5.1 节；官方脚本）。

与论文评测的通用 mobile-agent 系统相比——execution 实验包括 UI-TARS-1.5-7B——FingerTip 20K 改变的是数据与评测面，而不是提出新的 agent architecture：纵向用户身份、画像、时间/场景、历史 intent 与检索到的同用户行为成为显式输入。它代表的方向是个性化、主动式 mobile-agent data，而不是新的 Android 动作词表或自动验证环境。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and collection. Ninety-five crowdworkers in mainland China were instructed to invoke the collection app when they had a real current phone intent, record that intent and a location/scenario category, and demonstrate the operation on their daily-use Android phone. Each participant collected for one month with at most 12 uploads per day. The recorder stores user ID, timestamp, app/activity, screenshots, accessibility trees, and actions; a separate profile table includes sex, age, occupation, address, marital/family status, and phone brand (Paper §4.2, Figure 3, Appendix A.1/A.3/A.4; official README and CSVs).

Interaction and output. Each screenshot aligns with an action from click, long_click, type, scroll, press_back, press_home, press_recent, wait, and terminal finish/finished; the release also stores the corresponding accessibility-tree XML. An episode directory is keyed by user and timestamp and contains the intent description, context, JPG/XML observations, and JSONL action trace. The collector adds finish to the last screenshot, but the schema has no dense reward or independently verified per-episode success field (Paper Table 2, Appendix A.4/A.7; official repository).

Quality and privacy filtering. Collectors were trained to avoid ambiguous intents, redundant or useless operations, and excessively fast or repetitive actions. Timed manual checks removed low-quality episodes while retaining minor realistic mistakes. Participants signed a data-usage agreement, were warned not to upload private information, could inspect/delete uploads during collection, and collected only when actively invoking the app. Obvious privacy cases were manually removed; Qwen-VL-Max then screened first and last screenshots, and humans rechecked flagged episodes. Numeric rejection thresholds, removal counts, the privacy rubric, and the agreement text are undisclosed (Appendix A.3).

Splits and release audit. The paper reports train 16,000/177,674 screenshots, validation 4,411/32,859, suggestion test 1,000/10,412, and execution test 200/2,074; test examples come from each user's last 20% chronologically, while training is sampled from the first 60%, so the main split is not user-disjoint. In the official CSVs, train_set.csv has 16,000 unique keys; test_suggestion.csv has 1,000 rows but only 996 unique (user_id,time) keys because four rows are exact duplicates; test_execution.csv has 200 unique keys. The tests share 172 unique keys, corresponding to 174 suggestion-row occurrences because two duplicated suggestion keys are also in execution. No validation CSV or corpus-wide deduplication/decontamination procedure is released (Paper Appendix A.5, Table 7; official CSV audit).

Benchmark pipeline. Suggestion builds one prompt from profile, time, scenario, up to 20 previous intents, and 0–3 screenshots, then scores the Chinese intent sentence with Sim1 and paper-only SR1. Execution retrieves the most intent-similar earlier same-user action sequence, prompts on the current screenshot/accessibility elements and action history, executes the predicted action through ADB/uiautomator2, and repeats until finished() or the 2.5× step limit. SR2 still requires manual final-state review; the released result writer initializes and records success=0 rather than performing that review.

Training and reproducibility. The authors separately format the two tracks for LoRA SFT of Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, using rank 4 or 64 and either 1,000 proportionally sampled episodes or all 16,000; a joint-model ablation is also reported. No RL, RLVR, preference modeling, reward modeling, or PRM training is disclosed. Loss, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, epochs, seed, training code, configurations, and checkpoints are unknown. Reproduction must pin arXiv v2, GitHub commit e73a4dac3bd13ea32b7836525ff074a69cb047ea, and Kaggle version 2, then separately reconstruct training and the live device/app state; the public release supplies neither a resettable environment nor a deterministic replay bundle.

输入与采集。 中国大陆 95 名 crowdworker 被要求在产生真实手机使用 intent 时主动打开采集 app，记录该 intent 和地点/场景类别，并在日常使用的 Android 手机上示范操作。每位参与者采集一个月，每天最多上传 12 个 episode。记录器保存 user ID、时间戳、app/activity、screenshot、accessibility tree 和动作；单独的 profile 表还包含性别、年龄、职业、地址、婚姻/家庭状况与手机品牌（论文第 4.2 节、图 3、附录 A.1/A.3/A.4；官方 README 与 CSV）。

交互与输出。 每张 screenshot 与一个动作对齐，动作空间包括 click、long_click、type、scroll、press_back、press_home、press_recent、wait 和终止动作 finish/finished；发布内容也保存相应的 accessibility-tree XML。episode 目录以用户和时间戳为键，包含 intent 描述、上下文、JPG/XML 观测和 JSONL 动作轨迹。采集程序在最后一张 screenshot 上增加 finish，但 schema 没有 dense reward，也没有经独立验证的逐 episode 成功字段（论文表 2、附录 A.4/A.7；官方仓库）。

质量与隐私过滤。 采集者接受培训，被要求避免歧义 intent、冗余或无用操作，以及过快或重复动作。定期人工检查删除低质量 episode，但保留少量真实交互错误。参与者签署数据使用协议，被告知不要上传隐私信息，在采集期间可检查/删除上传内容，并且只有主动调用 app 时才采集。明显隐私样本先由人工删除，再由 Qwen-VL-Max 检查首尾 screenshot，最后人工复核被标记的 episode。量化拒绝阈值、删除数量、隐私 rubric 与协议文本均未披露（附录 A.3）。

划分与发布审计。 论文报告 train 16,000/177,674 张 screenshot、validation 4,411/32,859、suggestion test 1,000/10,412、execution test 200/2,074；测试样本来自每位用户按时间排序的最后 20%，训练从前 60% 采样，因此主划分并非 user-disjoint。官方 CSV 中，train_set.csv 有 16,000 个唯一键；test_suggestion.csv 有 1,000 行，但四行是完全重复项，因此只有 996 个唯一 (user_id,time) 键；test_execution.csv 有 200 个唯一键。两个测试集共享 172 个唯一键；由于其中两个 suggestion 键自身重复，按 suggestion 行计为 174 次重叠。官方未发布 validation CSV，也未披露 corpus-wide deduplication/decontamination 流程（论文附录 A.5、表 7；官方 CSV 审计）。

Benchmark pipeline。 Suggestion 将画像、时间、场景、最多 20 条历史 intent 和 0–3 张 screenshot 组成一次 prompt，再用 Sim1 和只在论文中实现的 SR1 评价中文 intent 句子。Execution 按 intent 相似度检索一条同用户早期动作序列，结合当前 screenshot/accessibility element 与动作历史发起 prompt，通过 ADB/uiautomator2 执行预测动作，直到 finished() 或达到 2.5× 步数上限。SR2 仍需人工检查最终手机状态；公开结果写入逻辑只是初始化并写入 success=0，并没有执行人工复核。

训练与复现。 作者分别为两个 track 格式化数据，用 LoRA 对 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 做 SFT，rank 为 4 或 64，使用按比例抽样的 1,000 个 episode 或全部 16,000 个 episode；论文还报告 joint-model ablation。没有证据支持 RL、RLVR、preference modeling、reward modeling 或 PRM training。Loss、optimizer、learning rate、batch size、epoch、seed、训练代码、配置与 checkpoint 都是 unknown。复现时必须固定 arXiv v2、GitHub commit e73a4dac3bd13ea32b7836525ff074a69cb047ea 与 Kaggle version 2，再单独重建训练及 live device/app 状态；公开发布既没有 resettable environment，也没有 deterministic replay bundle。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main training evidence is a controlled Qwen-2.5-VL-7B LoRA comparison on the authors' two tasks. With the full 16,000-episode training set and rank 64, proactive suggestion changes from SR1 3.1% and Sim1 0.25 before fine-tuning to 26.0% and 0.55 after fine-tuning. Personalized execution changes from SR2 1.5%, Sim2 0.95, and step ratio 2.16 to 15.5%, 1.42, and 1.13 (Paper §5.4, Table 5). These are author-reported results; the release has no training script or checkpoint for independent reconstruction.

The benchmark also exposes a large remaining gap. With zero initial screenshots, the best tested generalist proactive system reaches SR1 12.8%, while the human reference reported by the authors is 30.3%. For execution, UI-TARS-1.5-7B reaches SR2 38.5%; most un-fine-tuned Sim2 values remain near 1, meaning their action sequences are not substantially more similar to the current user's behavior than to a different user type (Paper §5.2, Tables 3–4). These results define the tested benchmark surface, not general mobile-agent reliability.

The execution fine-tuning result is especially important to interpret conservatively: 15.5% SR2 remains low even after the reported increase, and SR2 was manually judged from the final phone state. The 2.5× action-length cutoff can fail a valid but longer path, whereas Sim2 can reward action-string resemblance without proving functional completion. The public execution script does not reproduce the manual label and writes success=0, so its output alone cannot recover the paper's SR2 (Paper §5.1; official personalized_execution.py).

Artifact inspection supplies independent audit evidence about release shape, not independent reproduction of model results. At the pinned GitHub commit, total.csv has 20,000 rows, 83 users, and 482 app identifiers; test_suggestion.csv has 1,000 rows but 996 unique episode keys, and it overlaps execution on 172 unique keys. Kaggle version 2 declares CC BY 4.0 for the dataset, while the repository has no code license or tagged release. These checks show that paper counts, released rows, and unique evaluation units must be reported separately.

The evidence supports a narrower conclusion than benchmark promotion language might suggest: longitudinal human episodes can train and evaluate personalized mobile behaviors under this setup, and full-data SFT improves the reported metrics. It does not establish that the released subset is representative of the full paper corpus, that trajectories are intrinsically high quality, that scores are contamination-free, or that a live phone state can be reset and replayed.

主要训练证据是在作者两个任务上对 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 做 LoRA 的受控比较。使用全部 16,000 个训练 episode 和 rank 64 时，proactive suggestion 从微调前的 SR1 3.1%、Sim1 0.25 变为微调后的 26.0% 和 0.55；personalized execution 则从 SR2 1.5%、Sim2 0.95、step ratio 2.16 变为 15.5%、1.42 和 1.13（论文第 5.4 节、表 5）。这些结果由作者报告；公开发布没有训练脚本或 checkpoint，不能据此独立重建。

Benchmark 同时显示仍有很大差距。在没有初始 screenshot 时，测试过的最佳通用 proactive 系统达到 SR1 12.8%，作者报告的人类参照是 30.3%。Execution 上，UI-TARS-1.5-7B 达到 SR2 38.5%；多数未微调模型的 Sim2 仍接近 1，表示其动作序列相对其他用户类型，并没有明显更接近当前用户的行为（论文第 5.2 节、表 3–4）。这些数字界定的是论文测试的 benchmark surface，不是一般性的移动智能体可靠性。

Execution 微调结果尤其需要保守解释：即使有所上升，SR2 仍只有 15.5%，且该指标来自对最终手机状态的人工判断。2.5× 动作长度限制可能把更长但有效的路径判为失败，而 Sim2 可能奖励动作字符串相似，却不能证明功能完成。公开 execution 脚本没有复现人工标签，且把 success 写成 0，因此单靠该脚本输出无法恢复论文的 SR2（论文第 5.1 节；官方 personalized_execution.py）。

官方 artifact 的直接检查提供了发布形态的独立审计证据，但不是对模型结果的独立复现。在固定的 GitHub commit 上，total.csv 有 20,000 行、83 位用户和 482 个 app 标识；test_suggestion.csv 有 1,000 行但只有 996 个唯一 episode key，与 execution test 共享 172 个唯一键。Kaggle version 2 为数据集声明 CC BY 4.0，而代码仓库没有 code license，也没有 tagged release。这些检查说明论文计数、发布行数和唯一评测单元必须分开报告。

因此，证据支持的结论比 benchmark 宣传式解读更窄：在论文设置下，纵向人类 episode 可以用于训练和评测个性化移动行为，full-data SFT 也改善了作者报告的指标。证据不能证明公开子集代表完整论文语料、轨迹本身必然高质量、分数没有 contamination，或 live phone state 可以 reset 与 replay。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline in the paper is general mobile-agent evaluation centered on a supplied task and current UI state. Tested systems include UI-TARS-1.5-7B for execution. FingerTip 20K changes the problem formulation by making behavior longitudinal and user-conditioned: proactive suggestion must infer an intent before it is given, while execution can use profile data and retrieved earlier behavior from the same user (Paper §§3 and 5).

The new data object is the link among a self-recorded real-life intent, profile, timestamp/scenario, screenshot/XML state sequence, and human actions over one month of use. The new feedback interface is not a single automatic environment reward; it combines semantic similarity and a DeepSeek-V3 judgment for suggestion with manual terminal inspection, a path-length cutoff, and action-sequence similarity for execution. This combination makes user-specific context and mixed verification first-class audit objects.

Several components are established rather than new: Android GUI actions, screenshot and accessibility-tree observations, human demonstration collection, similarity metrics, learned judging, retrieval of examples, LoRA, Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, and live ADB execution. The title's “20K” is a rounded dataset name, not evidence of 20,000 unique tasks, and the paper's 21,437 collected episodes do not resolve to the public 20,000-row index. Scale and downstream scores are not record-level quality guarantees.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that agent episodes can encode persistent user context and can be consumed both as demonstration targets and as evaluation references. Reuse must still verify which user/profile fields are necessary, whether personalization gains survive privacy-preserving ablations, how final success is adjudicated, and whether alternate valid paths are penalized. Builders must also reconcile the count/split discrepancies, obtain the missing training implementation, and pin the changing Android/app substrate before treating the release as reproducible.

论文中的 prior-work baseline 是以已给定任务和当前 UI 状态为中心的通用 mobile-agent evaluation，execution 实验包括 UI-TARS-1.5-7B。FingerTip 20K 改变了问题定义，使行为具有纵向性并以用户为条件：proactive suggestion 要在 intent 尚未给定时推断它，execution 则可利用画像和从同一用户早期行为中检索的示例（论文第 3、5 节）。

新的数据对象把真实生活中自记录的 intent、画像、时间/场景、screenshot/XML 状态序列和一个月使用期间的人类动作连接起来。新的反馈接口不是单一 automatic environment reward：suggestion 结合语义相似度与 DeepSeek-V3 判断，execution 结合人工终态检查、路径长度上限与动作序列相似度。由此，用户特定上下文和 mixed verification 成为一等审计对象。

不少组件来自既有做法，而非本文新创：Android GUI 动作、screenshot 与 accessibility-tree 观测、人类示范采集、相似度指标、learned judge、示例检索、LoRA、Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 和 live ADB execution。标题中的 “20K” 是取整后的数据集名称，不代表 20,000 个唯一任务；论文的 21,437 个采集 episode 也无法直接对应公开的 20,000 行索引。规模与下游分数都不是逐记录质量保证。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向意义在于 agent episode 可以编码持续用户上下文，并同时作为 demonstration target 与 evaluation reference。复用前仍需检验哪些用户/画像字段确有必要、个性化收益能否在保护隐私的 ablation 中保留、最终成功如何裁决，以及其他有效路径是否会被错误惩罚。构建者还必须解释数量/划分差异、取得缺失的训练实现，并固定不断变化的 Android/app substrate，才能把发布视为可复现对象。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Corpus and split boundary: the paper reports 21,437 episodes, 95 users, and 506 apps, but the official index exposes 20,000 rows, 83 users, and 482 app identifiers. The missing mapping, validation index, and reduction rationale are unknown. The suggestion test has four exact duplicate rows and shares 172 unique keys with execution; treating rows as unique tasks or the tests as disjoint would misstate evidence.
  • Feedback boundary: SR1 depends on a DeepSeek-V3 same-intent judgment that the released proactive script does not implement. SR2 depends on manual final-state inspection absent from the execution script, whose success output is always initialized/written as 0. Judge bias, adjudicator inconsistency, surface similarity, and the 2.5× cutoff can produce false positives or false negatives relative to useful task completion.
  • Environment and replay boundary: episodes preserve screenshots, XML, and actions, but not per-episode app/APK versions, Android builds, accounts, initial states, network/service state, reset procedures, or deterministic replay manifests. Live UI drift and grounding failures can change outcomes independently of personalization or reasoning quality; the release is therefore an offline corpus plus live-evaluation code, not a resettable environment.
  • Selection and failure boundary: manual checks delete low-quality data, minor human noise remains, and every retained trace receives a finish marker. No explicit success/failure field proves the intended outcome, rejection counts and rubrics are unknown, and failed model rollouts/results are not released. Filtering may remove hard cases, and finish must not be interpreted as independent success verification.
  • Training and experimental boundary: only Qwen-2.5-VL-7B is fine-tuned, and loss, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, epochs, seed, code, configurations, and checkpoints are undisclosed. The experiments support SFT and evaluation only; they do not validate RL/RLVR, preference/reward modeling, PRM use, or broad cross-model and cross-region generalization.
  • Privacy, rights, and release boundary: all contributors are in mainland China and primarily use Chinese third-party apps. Longitudinal screenshots, locations/scenarios, usage history, and detailed profiles create re-identification and sensitive-content risks despite manual/Qwen-VL-Max filtering. Kaggle version 2 declares CC BY 4.0 for the dataset, but the code license is unknown, third-party UI/content rights are not resolved, consent text and post-release deletion policy are undisclosed, and the planned collection-app release is absent.
  • Contamination boundary: the main split is temporal within users, so train and tests share all 83 released users and may share apps, intent classes, and habitual patterns. No corpus-wide deduplication or benchmark decontamination method is disclosed. Any gain attributed to personalization should therefore be tested against memorization, repeated intent templates, and overlap-aware baselines.

• 语料与划分边界： 论文报告 21,437 个 episode、95 位用户和 506 个 app，但官方索引只有 20,000 行、83 位用户和 482 个 app 标识；缺失映射、validation index 与缩减原因均为 unknown。Suggestion test 有四行完全重复项，并与 execution 共享 172 个唯一键；把行数当成唯一任务数或把两个测试集当成互斥集合都会误报证据。
  • 反馈边界： SR1 依赖 DeepSeek-V3 的 same-intent 判断，但公开 proactive 脚本没有实现该判断。SR2 依赖人工检查最终手机状态，公开 execution 脚本没有这个步骤，其 success 一直初始化/写为 0。Judge bias、裁决者不一致、表面相似度和 2.5× 长度限制，相对于真正有用的任务完成都可能造成 false positive 或 false negative。
  • 环境与回放边界： episode 保存 screenshot、XML 与动作，却没有逐 episode 的 app/APK 版本、Android build、账号、初始状态、网络/服务状态、reset 流程或 deterministic replay manifest。Live UI drift 与 grounding failure 可以在个性化或推理质量不变时改变结果；因此该发布是离线语料加 live-evaluation code，不是 resettable environment。
  • 筛选与失败边界： 人工检查删除低质量数据，少量人类噪声被保留，每条保留轨迹都添加 finish 标记。没有显式 success/failure 字段证明 intent 确实完成，拒绝数量与 rubric 未披露，失败模型 rollout/result 也未发布。过滤可能去除难例，finish 不能解释为独立成功验证。
  • 训练与实验边界： 只有 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 被微调，loss、optimizer、learning rate、batch size、epoch、seed、代码、配置与 checkpoint 均未披露。实验只支持 SFT 与 evaluation，不能外推到 RL/RLVR、preference/reward modeling、PRM，或广泛的跨模型、跨地域泛化。
  • 隐私、权利与发布边界： 所有参与者来自中国大陆，主要使用中文第三方 app。纵向 screenshot、地点/场景、使用历史与详细画像即使经过人工/Qwen-VL-Max 过滤，仍会产生重识别与敏感内容风险。Kaggle version 2 为数据集声明 CC BY 4.0，但 code license 是 unknown，第三方 UI/content 权利未解决，consent 文本与发布后删除政策未披露，论文计划开放的 collection app 也不在仓库中。
  • 污染边界： 主划分按用户内部时间划分，train 与两个 test 共享全部 83 位发布用户，也可能共享 app、intent class 与习惯模式。论文未披露 corpus-wide deduplication 或 benchmark decontamination。任何归因于个性化的收益都应通过 memorization、重复 intent 模板与 overlap-aware baseline 进一步检验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, FingerTip 20K is a concrete schema and audit case for longitudinal agent episodes. A builder can preserve the episode container—intent, profile lookup, timestamp/scenario, screenshot/XML observation sequence, actions, and app/activity provenance—then compare context-free SFT against profile-, history-, or retrieved-demonstration conditioning. The track should remain at full-episode and state–action granularity; flattening steps without user/time/split lineage would erase the paper's central object.

The two evaluation tracks are useful as verifier-design studies. Suggestion can compare embedding/edit similarity with an explicitly versioned judge and human review. Execution can compare manual final-state completion, step budgets, trajectory similarity, alternate-path acceptance, and state-change predicates. A faithful implementation must add the missing DeepSeek-V3 SR1 call or replace it transparently, and must implement an auditable manual or environmental success adjudicator instead of trusting the released success=0 field.

For data construction, the collection protocol offers a starting point for real-intent longitudinal demonstrations, but a stronger replication should retain rejection reasons, explicit outcome labels, failed/abandoned demonstrations, privacy decisions, consent version, per-episode device/app versions, and reset/replay metadata. It should publish unique-key manifests and disjoint/overlap-aware evaluation views so that the 1,000-row/996-key suggestion split and its 172-key execution overlap cannot be hidden by headline counts.

For SFT research, the release supports only the supervised uses demonstrated in the paper: separate proactive and execution formatting for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B LoRA, plus the reported joint-model ablation. It can seed ablations on amount of user history, profile minimization, retrieval leakage, and privacy-preserving personalization. It should not be represented as an RL reward source, replayable online-training environment, preference dataset, or process-reward corpus.

Reuse class: evaluation and audit reference after pinning the GitHub/Kaggle snapshot; unrestricted training reuse is blocked pending privacy and rights review. Kaggle declares CC BY 4.0 for dataset version 2, but code licensing, third-party app-content rights, consent scope, post-release deletion, and the paper/public-index mapping remain unresolved. Benchmark improvements motivate targeted experiments; they do not certify the data's quality, safety, or replayability.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data 方向，FingerTip 20K 是纵向智能体 episode 的具体 schema 与审计案例。构建者可以保留完整 episode 容器——intent、profile lookup、时间/场景、screenshot/XML 观测序列、动作以及 app/activity provenance——再比较无用户上下文 SFT 与画像、历史或检索示范条件化。该对象应保持 full-episode 和 state–action 粒度；若在丢失用户、时间与 split lineage 的情况下扁平化步骤，就会抹去论文的核心对象。

两个 evaluation track 可用于研究 verifier design。Suggestion 可以比较 embedding/edit similarity、显式固定版本的 judge 与人工复核；execution 可以比较人工终态完成、步数预算、trajectory similarity、其他有效路径接受规则与 state-change predicate。忠实实现必须补上缺失的 DeepSeek-V3 SR1 调用，或透明地说明替代方案；还必须实现可审计的人工或 environmental success adjudicator，而不能相信公开的 success=0 字段。

在 data construction 上，该采集协议可作为真实 intent 纵向示范的起点，但更强的复现应保留拒绝原因、显式 outcome label、失败/放弃示范、隐私决策、consent 版本、逐 episode 设备/app 版本以及 reset/replay metadata。还应发布 unique-key manifest 与互斥或 overlap-aware 的评测视图，避免 1,000 行/996 键的 suggestion split 及其与 execution 的 172 键重叠被 headline count 掩盖。

在 SFT 研究上，发布只支持论文实际演示的监督用途：分别为 proactive 与 execution 格式化数据，对 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 做 LoRA，以及论文报告的 joint-model ablation。它可以支持用户历史长度、画像最小化、retrieval leakage 与 privacy-preserving personalization 的消融，但不能被描述为 RL reward source、可回放 online-training environment、preference dataset 或 process-reward corpus。

复用等级：固定 GitHub/Kaggle 快照后可用作 evaluation 与 audit reference；不受限制的训练复用在隐私和权利审查完成前受阻。Kaggle 为 dataset version 2 声明 CC BY 4.0，但 code license、第三方 app content 权利、consent 范围、发布后删除机制及论文/公开索引映射均未解决。Benchmark 提升可以推动针对性实验，却不能认证数据质量、安全性或可回放性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Table 1, §4.2, and Appendix A.4 first: “20K” refers to longitudinal human Android episodes, not 20,000 unique tasks or model rollouts; the paper reports 21,437 episodes.
  • Keep the public-release audit beside the paper statistics: total.csv exposes 20,000 rows, 83 users, and 482 app identifiers, with no official explanation for the 21,437/95/506 gap.
  • Read §5.1 with both official scripts: SR1 is absent from the proactive implementation, while execution success requires external manual final-state review and the public script writes success=0.
  • Treat split units carefully: suggestion has 1,000 rows but 996 unique episode keys, and 172 unique keys overlap the 200-key execution test; the main split is temporal within users.
  • Before reuse, pin arXiv v2, GitHub commit e73a4dac3bd13ea32b7836525ff074a69cb047ea, and Kaggle version 2, then resolve code licensing, privacy/consent scope, training details, and live-environment reset/replay metadata.

• 先读论文表 1、第 4.2 节与附录 A.4：“20K” 指纵向人类 Android episode，不是 20,000 个唯一任务或模型 rollout；论文实际报告 21,437 个 episode。
  • 阅读论文规模时必须并列查看公开发布审计：total.csv 只有 20,000 行、83 位用户和 482 个 app 标识，官方没有解释它与 21,437/95/506 的差异。
  • 将第 5.1 节与两个官方脚本对读：proactive 实现缺少 SR1，execution success 需要外部人工终态复核，而公开脚本只写入 success=0。
  • 谨慎区分 split 单位：suggestion 有 1,000 行但只有 996 个唯一 episode key，其中 172 个唯一键与 200 键的 execution test 重叠；主划分是在用户内部按时间完成的。
  • 复用前固定 arXiv v2、GitHub commit e73a4dac3bd13ea32b7836525ff074a69cb047ea 与 Kaggle version 2，并解决 code license、隐私/consent 范围、训练细节以及 live environment 的 reset/replay metadata。

items: DeepSeek-V3 same-intent judgments can be judge-biased and the released proactive script does not implement SR1.
Execution success is manually inspected and the released script writes success=0 without implementing adjudication.
Levenshtein-based action similarity can reward surface-sequence resemblance rather than functional personalization.
The 2.5x golden-length cutoff can reject valid but longer alternative paths.
Live app/UI drift and grounding errors change the terminal state independently of high-level reasoning quality.
DeepSeek-V3 同意图判断可能有评审模型偏差，且已发布的 proactive 脚本未实现 SR1。
执行成功由人工检查，已发布脚本写入 success=0 而不实现裁决。
基于 Levenshtein 的动作相似度可奖励表面序列相似而非功能性个性化。
2.5x golden 长度截止可拒绝有效但更长的替代路径。
实时应用/UI 漂移与锚定错误会独立于高层推理质量改变终态。

Fine-grained screenshots and longitudinal profiles retain re-identification risk.
